note: Both sets are accurate on the shared core facts (solar envelope 18'-0", grade 0'-0", finished floor 2'-9 1/2", 2 x APSE-20 / 40 tubes, cement fibre board siding, 2x4 cedar handrails, powdercoated steel flatbar railing posts, 1x4 T&G cedar cladding), with no misread or invented values in either. A is more complete on window/door marks (1.03, 1.05, 1.14, 1.13, 1.01, 1.02, 1.06) and captures the door-swing convention and the 1/4" scale, but repeats the handrail claim four times and restates the tube type. B adds the PV solar array, the 1/8" steel cable railing and the A-511 Hardie reference, but spends three claims on the PV array (two of them vague/trivial) and omits the scale and door-swing note. Overall coverage and fidelity are about equal.
